# Tome

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: A host 404 page only: the Magical Tome product is not served at tome.app, so this records that shutdown surface and not a presentation editor.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. https://tome.app/ and /login both return the host 404. No email form, so no signup. No payment.. Themes: dark, light.

Public capture of [https://tome.app/](https://tome.app/) on 2026-11-19. The Magical Tome presentation product is not served. The domain returns HTTP 404 with the title "404: NOT_FOUND" and the status line "404 DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND". The same page is what `/login` returns. There is no email form, so no account was created. No payment, phone, or SSO flow was opened.

The values below are the host 404 page's own computed styles, in the dark color scheme the attached browser used and the light scheme a headless capture emulated. They are not Tome's product system. Viewports measured: 1169×731 and 1440×900 on desktop, 390×844 on phone, all at device pixel ratio 2.

## Typography

4 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: geist, geist mono.

### Fonts (from README.md)

The page asks for Geist, then `-apple-system`, `system-ui`, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, and sans-serif. Metadata and the footer actions ask for Geist Mono, then SF Mono, Consolas, Liberation Mono, Menlo, and monospace. No `@font-face` loaded either family. The tokens keep the requested stack and fall back to the system faces.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

These tokens describe the host's 404 page. They do not describe Tome's presentations, editor, or marketing site, which this domain no longer serves. Geist and Geist Mono are named in `font-family` and were not loaded, so the painted face is the next fallback. The primary "Go back" button is in the DOM with `hidden` set. Its height, radius, padding and colours are computed, and it is not on screen. Hover colours are the stylesheet's custom properties. A visible control was not hovered. The per-request `sin1::` id under the status line changes on every load and is not a token.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Treat this as a shutdown record.** The page says the deployment was not found. [screenshots/home-dark-desktop.png](screenshots/home-dark-desktop.png) is the whole public surface.
- **Keep the two schemes.** Dark is `#0a0a0a` with `#ededed` text. Light is `#ffffff` with `#171717` text. [screenshots/home-light-desktop.png](screenshots/home-light-desktop.png) shows the light page.
- **Use the 6px control radius and the 2px blue focus ring.** The focused documentation link draws a `#0070f3` outline, 2px, offset 2px. [components/crops/secondary-link-focus.png](components/crops/secondary-link-focus.png).
- **Do not invent a Tome editor, a pricing table, or a wordmark from this page.** None of those are on it.
